tools.name: request_human
tools.description: Hand one blocked step to your human: a CAPTCHA, a 2FA/OTP code, an approval, or a sign-in your agent should not do alone. Pro acts: sends your person a one-tap link (to notify_webhook, Slack/Discord-compatible, and/or notify_email), returns request_id, and later an HMAC-signed POST to callback_url w

tools.name: check_request
tools.description: Poll a request: pending, done, approved, denied, code_ready, expired or cancelled. For 2fa_code, the code is returned exactly once (single read) and only within 10 minutes of the person sending it; then it is wiped.

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Cancel a pending request (for example your agent got past the step another way). The link stops working and any unread code is wiped.

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: Plain-English summary of the last 7 days: where your agent got stuck (by kind and by site), requests sent or that would have been, how many your person answered and how fast. Read-only; sends nothing. Needs a free API key.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $9/month upgrade link. Free tier: 500 calls/day. Not metered.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_human" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
